name: GeoGateNet: dual-path SchNet attention
tagline: Each layer fuses a SchNet-style continuous filter with softmax attention, gated by a learned residual sigmoid; readout combines attention pool plus sum pool.
formula:
$$m_{ij} = \mathrm{MLP}(h_i) \odot W(e_{ij}), \qquad \alpha_{ij} = \mathrm{softmax}_j\, \mathrm{MLP}([h_i, h_j, e_{ij}])$$
$$h_j' = h_j + \mathrm{LN}\bigl(g_j \odot \sum_i \alpha_{ij} m_{ij}\bigr), \quad g_j = \sigma(W_g [h_j, \mathrm{agg}_j])$$
diff_from_baseline: Goes beyond SchNet's pure continuous-filter convolution by adding softmax attention and a learned residual gate per layer; richer 7-type edge embedding (RBF + type + direction) and dual attention+sum readout instead of mean pool used in EGNN/SchNet baselines.

name: SE(3)-frame edge-update transformer
tagline: Multi-head graph transformer with edge-feature key/value bias, frame-aligned local geometry, and learned edge updates that propagate alongside node features.
formula:
$$\alpha_{ij} = \mathrm{softmax}_j \frac{q_i \cdot (k_j + W_k e_{ij})}{\sqrt{d_h}}, \qquad m_{ij} = \alpha_{ij} (v_j + W_v e_{ij})$$
$$h_i \leftarrow h_i + W_O \sum_j m_{ij} + \mathrm{FFN}(h_i), \qquad e_{ij} \leftarrow e_{ij} + \phi_e([h_i, h_j, e_{ij}])$$
diff_from_baseline: Replaces SchNet/EGNN scalar message passing with a graph transformer; adds residue-wise SE(3) frames so neighbor offsets become invariant local coordinates, and uniquely co-evolves edge features through every layer rather than fixing them at construction.

name: Curvature-gated dual-channel GNN
tagline: Spatial and sequential edges flow through separate MLP channels and are mixed by a per-node gate driven by local backbone curvature features.

key_hyperparams.name: seq_span
key_hyperparams.role: max sequence offset for seq edges

diff_from_baseline: Unlike SchNet's single-channel filter conv or EGNN's coordinate updates, every layer routes spatial vs sequential edges through separate MLPs and mixes them by a learned gate driven by per-node turn/bend curvature; readout fuses mean, max, sum and a curvature-modulated structural pool.

name: MSEPA: multi-scale RBF GNN
tagline: Splits radius edges into local/medium/long-range buckets, each with its own learned RBF projection, and reads out with attention plus mean plus max pooling.
diff_from_baseline: Replaces SchNet's single Gaussian-filter conv with three scale-specific RBF projections and a separate equivariant scalar+vector message block per layer; adds attention-based pooling rather than EGNN's mean or GearNet's sum readout.

name: Geometric attention with angular bias
tagline: Alternating geometric MP and multi-head attention layers; attention scores get a learned bias from per-edge distance, direction, density, and incoming-angle features.
formula:
$$\alpha_{ij} = \mathrm{softmax}_j\!\left(\frac{q_j \cdot k_i}{\sqrt{d_h}} + b_h(d_{ij}, d_{ij}^2, \hat r_{ij}, \rho_j, \cos\theta_{ij})\right)$$
$$h_j \leftarrow \mathrm{LN}(h_j + W_O \sum_i \alpha_{ij} v_i), \qquad h_{\text{out}} = W\!\left(\sum_\ell w_\ell h^{(\ell)}\right)$$
diff_from_baseline: Where SchNet uses scalar filters and EGNN updates coordinates equivariantly, this alternates per-layer between an angle-aware MP layer (using triplet angle, curvature, torsion proxies) and multi-head attention with a learned geometric-bias network; final readout aggregates all layers via a learned softmax weight plus a global virtual-node context.
